maria (Finance): FYI AtlasAP invoice PO3321 came in with a CA resale cert and an unsigned W-9. AP put a hold.
andrew (Accounting): Need signed W-9 with EIN. Resale cert doesn't apply for SaaS. Please ask vendor to reissue and separate the credit line.
leo (Vendor Ops): I'll request docs via vendor-docs template. Do we accept e-signed W-9s?
paige (Tax Counsel): E-sign is fine if it meets our onboarding policy. If they are foreign, they need a W-8 and withholding may apply. Confirm country of incorporation vs mailing address.
invoice-bot: ALERT: PO variance >10% — GL approval required.
AtlasAP (Vendor): Sending corrected invoice and e-signed W-9 now. Resale cert was attached by mistake. Sorry for confusion.
andrew (Accounting): Once we have W-9 and corrected invoice (promo as separate negative line), AP will process and we'll update vendor master with EIN/address.
maria (Finance): Holding until docs uploaded to Coupa. Marking pending. :white_check_mark:
leo (Vendor Ops): Uploaded files and tagged AP. Will follow up if not confirmed within 48h. :thumbsup:
paige (Tax Counsel): Note: confirm whether credit is a discount or reimbursement — affects tax treatment.
maria (Finance): Thanks all — closing when payment scheduled.
